idea-plugin.name: GH Actions
idea-plugin.description:
Shows GitHub Actions workflow runs of the repository the current project is cloned from.
  • List of workflow runs with jobs and steps and their statuses
  • Job and step logs
  • Run a workflow (workflow_dispatch, with inputs), re-run all / failed jobs, re-run a single job, re-run with debug logging, cancel a run
Authentication: token from Settings | Tools | GitHub Actions, GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN environment variables, or the GitHub CLI (gh auth token).
